_comment: Copy to profiles.json and fill in your team's backend URLs. profiles.json is
gitignored on purpose: this repo is public, and internal hostnames should not
end up in its history. Ask a teammate for the real values.
Mirror whatever env vars you normally pass to `npm run dev` for that stack.
Anything you leave out falls back to the PRODUCTION default in
points that one service at prod while the rest go to your stack.
The built-in `mock` and `prod` profiles need no configuration.
